howToUpdate: Each area has a lease half and a homes half. A lot matches only when the home fits and a lease of 7 years or more is on offer. Leave a half as Needs evidence when it is not on file. Do not add rates, names or emails.

base.summary: Until a council brief is on file, the Laurito screen is 3 to 4 bed homes where reserved matters have been discharged.

Manchester.note: The MCC Private Sector Leasing RFI is still due 30 Nov 2026.

lease.sevenNote: Break option can cut below the 7 year gate 14 base: Needs evidence on chosen option
lease.rentBasis: Guaranteed rent, set by zone and bed size, with an extra payment for adapted homes. It moves with inflation each year. Subject to break and maintenance.
lease.manager: Needs evidence. The council is the tenant and furnishes the home.
lease.whoCanLet: The landlord can be the freeholder, a long leaseholder, or a company holding a headlease longer than 10 years and a day.
lease.councilRole: The lease is registrable at HM Land Registry. The council handles stamp duty and registration.

accommodation.type: Houses or flats. Adapted homes at level 1, 2 or 3 to the council specification are in demand.
accommodation.boundary: Inside Manchester City Council. North: M8, M9, M40 and parts of M4. South or central: M1, M2, parts of M3, parts of M4, M11, M12, M13, M14, M15, parts of M16, M18, M19, M20, M21, M22, M23 and M90.
accommodation.condition: The landlord keeps up maintenance, holds a valid EPC, gas and electrical certificates, has mortgagee consent and their own solicitor, and has no council tax debt on the property.

Glasgow.note: The bid needs a credible pipeline of suitable homes, not completed purchases.

lease.sevenNote: Lease length is not on file, so the 7 year rule is Needs evidence.
lease.programme: 250 homes within 12 months. Indicative share about 25 homes, about 10%, not fixed.

accommodation.type: Suitable homes. 5% of the 250 home programme must be accessible, about 13 homes.
accommodation.boundary: Glasgow, as tagged on the feed. A tighter council boundary is not on file.

Edinburgh.note: The framework is live and no homes have been placed yet.

lease.sevenNote: Lease length is not on file, so the 7 year rule is Needs evidence.
lease.start: Live. A start date is not on file.

accommodation.type: Self-contained homes for one household. Shared houses are out. 12 to 16 bed supported accommodation is considered case by case.
accommodation.beds: 1 to 4. Strongest demand is 1, 3 and 4 bed. 2 bed is lower priority.
accommodation.boundary: City of Edinburgh only. Midlothian, East Lothian, West Lothian, Fife and the Scottish Borders are out.
accommodation.shops: Within 1.5 miles of a grocery shop and public transport.
accommodation.condition: The home must be capable of full compliance before call-off. That covers insurance, certification and licences. Minimum EPC and space standards are not specified.
accommodation.clustering: More than 2 temporary accommodation properties in one stair, or more than 20% in one street, needs a management strategy.

wants: Self-contained homes for one household, 1 to 4 bed, inside the City of Edinburgh boundary only.
Strongest demand is 1, 3 and 4 bed. 2 bed is lower priority.
Within 1.5 miles of a grocery shop and public transport.
More than 2 temporary accommodation properties in one stair, or more than 20% in one street, needs a management strategy.
Larger buildings and conversions are considered case by case. The council is seeking 12 to 16 bed supported accommodation that is HMO compliant, with en-suite rooms and staff space.
Home Share and Shared House intake is currently suspended.
The home must be capable of full compliance before call-off.
